newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.2 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.2 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $1.2 billion in 59 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $728 million in 21 sales, with a $220 million Delaware Valley Regional Finance, Pa., deal through Merrill Lynch topping the list.
On the competitive side, 38 sales totaling $432 million are scheduled. A $141 million Mississippi deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional six sales totaling $502 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
